items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: I played with Joe Oliver quite a while. In Ory's band. So in Kid Ory's band.

ctx.x: Yeah. You remember when Johnny Dodds came in the band or did Punch play with Ory too, didn't he a while?
Yeah, Punch played with Ory a while before he went with Jack Kelly.
